The provided onboarding document does not contain information regarding token display labels or formatting (such as distinguishing "Total input tokens sent this session" from "Current context sent per call").

**Best Guess:**
This appears to be a feature request or UI clarification for how token usage is reported in Hermes Agent's session logs or gateway outputs. Since this setting or text string is not documented as a user-configurable option in `config.yaml`, implementing this change would likely require updating the token reporting/formatting logic in the codebase (for instance, in the CLI session summary or gateway response handlers) and submitting a pull request to the repository.
